column2: On Linux: put the Steam launch option from the GUIDE (Linux and Steam Deck) and start MWCoop from Steam
MWCoop did not load: on Linux, put WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"version,winhttp=n,b\" %%command%% in the game's Steam launch options (GUIDE: Linux and Steam Deck)
\n\nOn Linux, the launch copies (with links to the game) are kept: delete them by hand, without following the links.
